subject.title: fix(codex): prefer the pinned runtime for current models

question: Should package-first be the permanent default for ordinary managed Codex turns, with desktop-first reserved only for Computer Use entitlement ownership?
rationale: The patch fixes a reproduced failure, but it intentionally changes the executable selected for existing macOS users, and tests cannot determine the desired long-term runtime ownership policy.

options.title: Adopt two-mode ordering
options.body: Use the pinned package first for ordinary turns and retain desktop-first only for Computer Use paths.

options.title: Pause for runtime negotiation
options.body: Hold the PR and design app-server version or capability negotiation instead of fixed ordering.

recommendation.title: Adopt two-mode ordering
recommendation.body: Use the pinned package first for ordinary turns and retain desktop-first only for Computer Use paths.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently maintained the affected runtime-selection and Computer Use paths.
